sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Metrics reloaded: recommendations for image analysis validation》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Increasing evidence shows that flaws in machine learning (ML) algorithm validation are an underestimated global problem.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Developed by a large international consortium in a multistage Delphi process, it is based on the novel concept of a problem fingerprint-a structured representation of the given problem that captures all aspects that are relevant for metric selection, from the domain interest to the properties of the target structure(s), dataset and algorithm output.

evidence.text: Increasing evidence shows that flaws in machine learning (ML) algorithm validation are an underestimated global problem.

Developed by a large international consortium in a multistage Delphi process, it is based on the novel concept of a problem fingerprint-a structured representation of the given problem that captures all aspects that are relevant for metric selection, from the domain interest to the properties of the target structure(s), dataset and algorithm output.
